name: codexdeck
description: Self-hosted web cockpit, 3rd-party API protocol gateway, and safe deploy-verify loop for OpenAI Codex CLI.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @codexdeck/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexdeck/ops-mcp build && pnpm --filter @codexdeck/server test && pnpm --filter @codexdeck/web test && pnpm --filter codex-deck test
scripts.dev:server: pnpm --filter @codexdeck/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexdeck/ops-mcp build && pnpm --filter @codexdeck/server dev
scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter @codexdeck/shared build && pnpm --filter @codexdeck/server exec tsx src/codex/smoke.ts
